title: NHPC Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 205 Trainee Engineer Posts
description: National Hydroelectric Power Corporation (NHPC) has issued an official notification for 205 Trainee Engineer Positions. Candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech in Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or B.Sc. can use this chance and apply for the NHPC Recruitment 2026 .
